pages.text:
SECTION 1
SLEEPYHEAD — SUPPLIED GUIDELINE EXCERPTS AND SOURCE INDEX
12 October 2026

AUTHORITY
These fifteen user-supplied screenshots are excerpts, not a complete brand book. No original document version/date/approval stamp, production logo artwork or font binaries/licences were supplied. Their source content guides Sleepyhead only. This assistant reading distinguishes stated guidance, observed examples and source conflicts. Never import another brand's identity. No model-weight training is claimed.

POSITIONING AND VISUAL IDENTITY
Human-centred, young/vibrant, quirky, fabulous; Jester archetype centred on connection and enjoyment. Friendly wit, creative surprise and informal approachable language. Brand orange #F15A22, charcoal #414042, white (RGB supports #FFFFFF but printed hex conflicts). Migrena Grotesque for brand and Source Sans Pro for web, subject to actual font availability. Lowercase authentic wordmark and ee eye monogram; preserve proportions, contrast and permitted variants. Spatial direction: playful colour/pattern, asymmetry, mixed styles, expressive shapes, coherent palette.

SOURCE CONFLICTS
S14: white RGB255,255,255 versus printed HEX#231F20. Store the discrepancy; #FFFFFF is an interpretation from RGB, pending corrected source. S10: app32x32 versus favicon16x16; retain application context, not universal minimum. S09 recommends a transparent logo patch in some cases; the explicit client scene-execution policy prohibits artificial patches/fades. Use actual architectural copy space and permitted logo treatment in scenes. Examples including serif social headlines and collage are examples, not a new universal typography or photo style rule.

SOURCE-BY-SOURCE READING
S01 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.12.41 AM.png
Asset: asset-c4381a7b-d5aa-46af-95a9-7e2150bd0e23
SHA256: 91b754c90c9ea832ad9b726d54e74ee4479818b20b5a366c29f193aff94db461
Reading: Human-centred, young and vibrant, quirky, fabulous. Customers at the core; social listening and active research. Youthful/young-at-heart Gen Z and Millennials are intended audiences, not validated customer demographics. Positive, energetic creative communication; humour and emotionally engaging experiences. Orange headings, grayscale cutout collage and colourful stickers are visible examples.

S02 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.12.52 AM.png
Asset: asset-aae80100-00e7-4b25-ad96-67df3e41702f
SHA256: 9b738d78e62f760809b7fb4ccf0aeaaca7cb4f4a5d3b2e2a0adba56ea3b946ef
Reading: Jester archetype: pursue connection/social; core desire enjoyment. Humour, wit, playful spirit, relatable messaging and interactive experiences build connection. Easy-going, jolly, living in the here and now. This is supplied positioning, not proof of consumer response.

S03 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.12.59 AM.png
Asset: asset-f5cbeb65-4e42-4c48-afb8-478919470599
SHA256: ea0f07d75fac150b53678157efc76194cc0a446e12f4d40dea01d2a36f89f5a6
Reading: Traits: playful, creative, unpredictable, energetic, irreverent. Unexpected touches, bold colours/patterns/textures, community and gently subverting convention. These explain personality; do not interpret irreverence as permission for cruelty or misleading claims.

S04 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.13.07 AM.png
Asset: asset-7842f272-0c93-4d13-95a0-f81f160c2277
SHA256: 5bd7c6211f9173683b7c119ee5acaa8025bef700872a05e0b296cd52147a9a24
Reading: Spatial/design ingredients: bold vibrant colours; stripes, dots or prints; asymmetrical art and mismatched cushions; vintage with modern or bohemian with industrial; quirky sculptures, oversized art and funky lighting. Keep a coherent palette/theme. Orange = bold, white = openness, grey = neutralise. Borrow principles, not specific third-party artwork or sculptures.

S05 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.13.12 AM.png
Asset: asset-fe0205c8-6774-40f4-9b95-f0e6827e968e
SHA256: 43802e14863517c7b7ce532dfe802e5053b1e554364f86a3a4b65f90ddd602c7
Reading: Voice: humorous, irreverent, informal, creative, personable. Witty one-liners, clever wordplay, unexpected jokes/metaphors, conversational approachable language; we/you for connection. Remain useful and clear; do not make unsupported product promises.

S06 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.13.18 AM.png
Asset: asset-d40ad768-1016-434e-af72-e29b24fc08ac
SHA256: 5ae2cc75509557a69d7dadfa83b7bf72fcaf38548be0577f1391b895541143a1
Reading: Master lowercase Sleepyhead wordmark: orange sleepy and charcoal head with integrated closed-eye ee motif and trademark. Logo anatomy shows clear space; orange labelled Wake Up Actively, grey Fall in Comfort. This screenshot documents artwork; it is not a production vector logo.

S07 | Screenshot 2026-10-12 at 2.13.24 AM.png

SHA256: bcbb3ec081de085a48db07fbe8944f1e2c12a25b680fb61970b6f95b02286940
Reading: Logo construction identifies Migrena Grotesque, bold lowercase wordmark and altered e letters forming closed eyes. Preserve the supplied mark, proportions and clear space. Diagram uses an e-based spacing construction; no numeric minimum for full wordmark is established here. USE IT WISELY display styling is a page example, not permission to add shadows to the logo.

SECTION 1
SLEEPYHEAD — SPATIAL WORLD RESEARCH AND APPLICATION
12 October 2026

USER DIRECTION
The user selected this Pinterest board for Sleepyhead and clarified: it is more than decor; it is the spaces Sleepyhead should be inspired by. Treat the whole room as the unit of inspiration: architecture, proportions, layout, colour relationships, material appearance, light, furniture grouping, lived-in activity and atmosphere. Objects are only one layer. Board: https://in.pinterest.com/nehas4991/sofa/

AUTHORITY AND COVERAGE
100 board entries accounted for; 102 rendered still images/thumbnails saved, including four carousel images. One video entry has no exposed still image. Videos were not downloaded, played or analysed. All 102 saved images inspected in six labelled contact sheets plus one full-size image; overview-level visual interpretation, not fine-detail/authenticity/material/licensing audit. Pinterest captions and alt text retained as unverified source descriptions. Screenshots S01–S15 inspected as supplied.
The board is client-selected inspiration, not mandatory brandbook rules or exact Sleepyhead product evidence. Some captions disclose AI imagery and P072 visibly includes an AI label; other creation histories are unknown. Descriptive family names below are assistant interpretations, not verified geographic origin or architecture attribution. Third-party brands/lettering appear in P096–P101; preserve source attribution but never transfer their logos, products or claims to Sleepyhead. Full videos remain unreviewed. Uploaded image files are board-resolution stills, not guaranteed original masters.

SPATIAL SYNTHESIS
The dominant language is optimistic, expressive and domestic. Soft rounded upholstery sits within recognisable rooms with windows, storage and activity zones. White/cream shells often allow pink, orange, yellow, cobalt, green and lilac to define furniture, wall planes or rugs; some rooms use a strong single-colour envelope. Pattern appears at a readable scale in checkerboards, stripes, waves and flowers. Timber, woven/ribbed/soft-textured surfaces temper glossy coloured lamps, transparent tables and ceramics. Daylight, plants, books and music/reading corners make spaces inhabited. A quieter subset proves that playful does not require saturation everywhere. Avoid reducing this collection to orange sofas, novelty props or a single maximalist formula.

SPATIAL FAMILIES — SELECTION AIDS
A. Bright expressive apartment: P001,P009,P017,P019,P030,P050,P060,P061,P063,P081,P094. Pale architecture, colour in a few large zones, graphic rug/art, sculptural low table, sunlit domestic layout. Useful default when brief needs youthful accessibility.
B. Pastel sculptural living: P004,P007,P012,P024,P034,P039,P051,P059,P062,P102. Curves, rounded furniture, ribbed softness, pastel walls, controlled stronger contrasts. Retain practical scale and avoid toy/showroom excess.
C. Retro graphic/creative home: P006,P025,P031,P035,P036,P048,P049,P054,P055,P057,P070,P071,P075,P078,P082,P090. Timber plus saturated colours, patterned rugs, records/art/books; an expressive resident rather than anonymous showroom. Industrial shell is optional.
D. Real compact connected home: P010,P022,P038,P065,P068,P069,P084,P086,P092,P095. Respect passageways, dining/living adjacency, storage and room depth; practical everyday architecture can carry playful style. P092 also has a ceiling fan. Adapt to an Indian brief without claiming reference locations are Indian.
E. Reading/social corners: P040–P044,P053,P074,P079,P082,P083. Window-side soft seat, useful shelf and light, intimate scale. P040–P043 are carousel variants, not four independent style endorsements.
F. Playful bedrooms: P005,P026,P073,P091. Colour repeats between wall/art/rug/textiles with real daylight and functional bedside space. Actual selected mattress/bed remains recognisable; never infer construction or change its fabric from these pictures.
G. Quieter colour-aware rooms: P002,P013,P016,P027,P044,P047,P076,P077,P078,P085,P087,P089,P090. Restrained shell, tactile grounding and selected bold accents. Useful alternative to busy rooms; preserve personality in shape/art/colour.
H. Adjacent architectural/detail vocabulary: P008,P011,P015,P018,P020,P029,P037,P045,P058,P067,P072,P088. Bathroom/kitchen/niche/detail references inform surfaces, geometry, colour transitions or light; they do not independently establish a complete living-room composition.
I. Lifestyle and competitor video stills: P096–P101. Limited evidence for relaxation, human scale, contact and atmosphere. Motion and claims unreviewed; these are weak spatial evidence compared with full-room images.

HOW TO BUILD A SLEEPYHEAD SPACE — ASSISTANT APPLICATION
1. Lock the exact Sleepyhead SKU and variant using its official product page. Product colour, fabric/pattern, proportions, construction, branding and documented features belong to that evidence, never to Pinterest furniture.
2. Choose one spatial family and a small coherent reference set. Write the room's purpose, scale, architecture/openings, circulation, wall/floor/ceiling relationship and light direction before choosing props.
3. Define a neutral or tonal envelope, one dominant chromatic anchor and a few recurring accents as a proposed compositional method, not a supplied numeric brand rule. Orange identifies the brand but need not recolour every wall/sofa. Complement the exact SKU.
4. Balance rounded upholstered forms with useful tables/storage and selected graphic pattern. Pick which layer carries pattern; avoid a dense pattern on every surface. Express personality through real resident activities: reading, music, socialising or lounging as relevant to the brief.
5. Choose plausible materials by appearance: painted walls, wood grain, fabric texture, reflective glass/metal or matte ceramics. Source photographs cannot prove exact composition, dimensions, costs or manufacturers.
6. Use physically coherent daylight/practical lamps, credible furniture scale, contact shadows, occlusion and body support. Some inspiration is synthetic; architectural fantasy is not physical evidence.
7. Reserve copy/logo space on a real wall/backdrop in the composition; no white patches, haze, artificial fades or blur masks. Borrow design principles, not literal slogans, branded artwork or competitor features.
8. Explain each chosen guideline-to-design connection in the new brief; distinguish intended application from actual rendered compliance. This archive is indexed guidance and inspiration, not a guarantee of rendering fidelity.

CONNECTION TO SUPPLIED GUIDELINES
S01–S03 justify youthful Jester energy and connection; room interpretation is assistant synthesis. S04 directly supports colour, pattern, asymmetry, mixed styles and coherent themes. S14–S15 define supplied colour choices with S14 conflict retained. S06–S12 govern identity legibility; references cannot recolour or distort the logo. S13 names brand/web typefaces but no licensed binaries are supplied. S05 informs approachable copy, not generic novelty signage copied from a pin.

All saved images were reviewed here at contact-sheet level with per-image notes below.
